test_title: PYST 54: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Naina is leaving and I am __think to apply__ for her job.
solution:
The correct answer is Option 2 i.e. **'thinking about applying'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Thinking about applying"** correctly uses the **gerund form "applying"** after the preposition "**about**," making the phrase grammatically correct and conveying the intended meaning of considering an action.
 
• It is the most natural and fluently used construction among the options for expressing contemplation or consideration of an action in English.

Therefore, the corrected sentence is- *Naina is leaving and I am thinking about applying__ for her job.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1)** "Thinking in applying"** - This construction is awkward and not standard in English for conveying the idea of considering an action.
 
• Option 3) **"Thinking about apply" **- The use of "apply" without the gerund "-ing" form after "about" makes this option grammatically incorrect in this context.
 
• Option 4) **"Thinking on applying" **- While "thinking on" can sometimes be used similarly to "thinking about," it is less common and sounds less natural in this context. "Applying" would be correct in terms of form, but "about" is the preferred preposition here.
